scope: Synchronous head-only public API latency incl GPU coarse+filter+compaction+Q8 sparse+GPU argmax and readback versus native Q8+GPU argmax. Four warmup blocks excluded. All measured symmetric six-call blocks (GPU native,bounded,CPU native,CPU native,bounded,GPU native) retained. External compile load uncontrolled, Raw greedy CPU reference includes full-logit download and scan with reused buffer; not model throughput/adoption.
